# Intent (template)

> In ESOI, intents are meaningful containers of a set of specifications. For human understanding, they serve as a personal category of interest or relate to a tangible container such as an organization.

Copy this file once per record. Answer every question; leave none empty. Give the record a short stable id (a few lowercase words joined by hyphens) so other records can link to it.

## What it is not

A general category like "parenting" or "career." An intent is also not an organization itself, rather the container of specification that clarifies why the organization exists (as a solution and implementation within an intent). In this example, different versions of the same organization can be documented as separate alternative implementations.
